p: lighter: Do not oppress us with such high taxes, which we are not able to pay.
servant unto this people this day: They showed him that there was no way to win the people's hearts but to grant them their just petition.
What counsel give ye that we: There is nothing harder for them that are in authority than to control their desires and follow good counsel.
thicker than my father's loins: I am much more able to keep you in subjection than my father was.
appointed: The people declare their obedience in this that they attempted nothing before the king gave them just opportunity.
David: Though their cause was good, yet it was hard for the people to control their desires, as these vile words declare.
of David unto this day: By the just judgment of God for Solomon's sins.
assembled all the house of Judah: For as yet he did not realize that the Lord had so appointed it.
man of God: That is, the Prophet.
LORD: Who of his just judgment will punish the trespasser, and of his mercy spare the innocent people.
at Jerusalem: He feared least his people should have by this means been enticed to rebel against him.
It is too much for you: So crafty are carnal persuasions of princes, when they will make a religion serve their appetite.
house of high places: That is, a temple, where altars were built for idolatry.
fifteenth day of the month: Because he would bind the people's devotion to his idolatry even more, he made a new holy day, besides those that the Lord had appointed in the law.
